assets.defect_engineered: name/description/macros/allergen/price are ONE continuous text story in ONE frame (not five frames); the mapping readout silently DROPS the allergen run while keeping its line break, so every offset past it is short by that run's length and the validator still returns VALID; there is a real per-page picture well (per-row binding possible) but NO bleed box (media box = trim)
assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for ironwood_linesheet_2027.pdf - last season's line-sheet press PDF (flat, one SKU per page; to be reverse-engineered into a live InDesign merge template downstream).

Document: A4 PORTRAIT, 210 x 297 mm, ONE SKU per page, fonts embedded (a single plain high-legibility grotesque sans throughout). NO bleed box present: trim = media box, 0 mm bleed. This is the exact file the label/press printer already runs for the line sheet.

WHAT EACH PAGE LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (one photo + five apparent fields):
- Top ~55% of the page: a placed PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPH, 4:3 landscape, one bowl per page.
- BOWL NAME: large bold grotesque, Ink Charcoal #23262A.
- DESCRIPTION: two lines, same family, regular weight, Ink Charcoal #23262A.
- MACRO LINE (kcal . protein . carbs . fat): small, Steel Grey #9AA0A6.
- ALLERGEN LINE ('Contains: ...'): Field Green #3F7D4E.
- PRICE ('$12'): large, Salsa Clay #E2593B, bottom-right.
- Ground: Bench White #F6F5F1.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- The BOWL NAME, DESCRIPTION, MACRO LINE, ALLERGEN LINE and PRICE are a SINGLE continuous text story in ONE text frame (name \n description \n macros \n allergens \n price), NOT five addressable frames. Five fields landing in one flow is a different mapping problem from five fields in five frames.
- The photograph sits in its own rectangular GRAPHIC FRAME. This IS a genuine picture well, so a per-row product photograph CAN be bound through the image column - but it must be bound per row or every page ships the same bowl.
- When the mapping readout (textContent) is taken off that story, the ALLERGEN run is SILENTLY DROPPED while its trailing line break is KEPT, so the readout still reads as a well-formed five-part block. Every character offset AFTER the allergen line is therefore short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns VALID with zero warnings on those wrong offsets and prepare reports completed successfully, so the PRICE (mapped by offset after the allergens) silently never lands and the ALLERGEN LINE itself is absent from every merged page - for a food business where the allergen line is not optional. The true story text must be reconstructed from the prepared document itself and every offset recomputed against it.
- NO BLEED: because the media box equals the trim and no bleed box exists, a bleed-safe press-ready delivery cannot be honoured from this file however the render is called.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): BOWL_NAME | DESCRIPTION | MACROS | ALLERGENS | PRICE | @IMAGE (per-row product photo).

Colours: Bench White #F6F5F1 ground, Ink Charcoal #23262A name & description, Steel Grey #9AA0A6 macros, Field Green #3F7D4E allergen line, Salsa Clay #E2593B price.

assets.content:
IRONWOOD KITCHEN - everything else you might need (for the freelancer)

THE TWO COUNTERS / HOURS
- Westminster Street counter and Point Street counter.
- Mon-Fri 7:30am to 2:30pm. Case restocked and full by 10:30am, usually cleared out by 2. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

THE THREE DELIVERY ROUTES (Providence) - drivers leave the printed sheet at reception on each
1. Jewelry District - the design and tech offices around Chestnut and Clifford. ~11:30 drop.
2. Capital Center - the tower loop by the train station. ~11:45 drop.
3. East Side / Point Street corporate park. ~12:00 drop.

CLEARED CLAIMS (only these two are signed off by our supplier - do NOT add or invent others)
- "Twenty-eight grams of protein or more in every bowl."
- "No added sugar in any of our dressings."

TILE / PLATFORM SIZES the delivery app and paid social ask for
- Delivery-app product tile: 1080 x 1080 (square).
- Paid feed video: 1080 x 1350 (4:5).
- Story / reel slot: 1080 x 1920 (tall, 9:16).
- Line-sheet photo well: 4 x 3 landscape, one photo per page.

A NOTE ON THE FEATURE
The featured bowl on the case screen and the tiles changes EVERY WEEK, so the caption cards have to be one file we can open and reskin ourselves in a minute - swap the bowl and the few words, touch nothing else.

A NOTE ON THE LOGO
All we have of the wordmark is the flat picture on white. The designer who made it has gone and there is no other file anywhere.
